text_block_list.name: Rental Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, part-timer-chan! Could I ask you to 
help out on the first floor?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Got it! The magazine corner, right? I saw 
a delivery arriving there just a moment 
ago...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' reaaal!? Ines, hey☆ Heading back from 
work~!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Nyah!? Helios-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that what they're holding?! 
Ines, that's your thing!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Satsuki Sho's No. 1 Uma Musume to 
watch! Hype, congrats, and cheers all 
around, ain't it!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what's with that~? It's dark out, 
so wanna walk back together?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaah, I wuv Ines so much~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Special Street Poll! Umamusume with high 
hopes for the Satsuki Sho"... huh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Why did you pick Ines Fujin? 
"Because I watched the Asahi Hai" "Because 
she looked like my sister" And then? And 
then...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...'Because I wanted to dream'.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you asking about my dream?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I have... star quality. Did 
something resonate with her? Or maybe 
she's aiming for the Derby...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha. But a "dream," huh...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Running in the Classic Triple Crown was 
my dream, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Since I'm getting to be so selfish right 
now, I've gotta pay everyone back 
properly. Yeah..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ring! Ring!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Hello! Su-chan, Lu-chan?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, are you done with dance practice? 
Onee-chan just got back to school too—

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um, you know. Well... Big sis, good 
luck in the Satsuki Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Do your best and take 1st place, okay? 
We're all going to the Derby to cheer you 
on~!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Su loves it too! Lu loves it too! 'Cause 
we just love Big Sis's races!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah, Big Sis too! I love you so 
much, Su-chan, Lu-chan~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
As their proud big sister, I'm gonna give 
it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a GⅠ just like the Asahi Hai FS. 
However, despite being the same grade, 
this Satsuki Sho is different in many 
ways.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
One is the first race of the Classic 
Triple Crown. Only the Umamusume who wins 
this race can challenge for the Triple 
Crown title.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What else?
choice_data_list:
It's the fact that you're getting so much 
attention.
The fact that you're in the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. I think I know that all too well 
from personal experience.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Does it feel like having a ton of people 
counting on you? Like a slight tingle 
right in the pit of your stomach?
choice_data_list:
And your rivals are keeping an eye on you 
too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Rival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Around the time of the Asahi Hai FS, there 
were still few umamusume who viewed Ines 
Fujin as a rival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, she will definitely be marked 
this time. There will surely be Umamusume 
who challenge her with reckless abandon.
choice_data_list: Stay sharp right from the start.
Stay sharp right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it turns into a fiercely 
contested race, I'm definitely going to 
win."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho paddock. 18 contenders 
make their entrance to kick off the first 
battle of the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Such incredible cheers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Ryan-chan. Today—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...You're in great shape, Ryan-chan. You 
seem a bit more confident than usual, 
maybe."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I pride myself on Nakayama 2000m 
being one of my strong suits."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Ines. I'll run with 
everything I've got and win.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I won't lose either.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha. Sparks flying doesn't even begin 
to describe this...!
